actions.name: Travel
actions.effect: When an encounter begins, roll Awareness for Initiative.

actions.name: Hustle
actions.effect: Attempt an Endure check. You can Hustle for a number of hours equal to 1/5 your check, rounded down, or else you become Fatigued. When an encounter begins, you can choose to use the results of the Endure check for Intiative, or your can roll Awareness.

actions.name: Search
actions.effect: Attempt an Awareness check; the GM applies it to one or more Stealth Thresholds to spot hidden objects and creatures. When an encounter begins, use the results of the Awareness check for Initiative.

actions.name: Avoid Notice
actions.description: You move quietly and keep to cover.
actions.effect: Attempt a Stealth check; the GM applies it to the one or more Awareness Threshold of anything that might notice you. When an encounter begins, you can choose to use the results of the Stealth check for Initiative, or you can roll Awareness.

actions.name: Scout
actions.effect: Every ally gains a +1 Situation bonus to Initiative, and you may immediately Step when you roll Initiative. When an encounter begins, roll Awareness for Initiative.

actions.name: Defend
actions.effect: Your shield begins Raised. When an encounter begins, when an encounter begins, roll Awareness for Initiative.

actions.name: Look Harmless
actions.requirements: You wield no weapon with a Reach greater than 1, and your worn armor totals Load 1 or less.
actions.description: Hands empty, eyes down, pace unhurried. You are not hiding. You are simply not worth watching.
actions.effect:
When an encounter begins, you may roll Guile for Initiative. Compare the roll against the Awareness of each enemy that you are Observed to, with the following effects:
Critical Success They are Wrong-Footed to you until the end of your first Opportunity.
Success They are Wrong-Footed to your first attack.
Failure Nothing; they were watching you all along.
Critical Failure You overplayed it. You are Wrong-Footed to them until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Investigate
actions.effect: Roll a Relevant check; the GM applies it to the Thresholds to potentially recall or discover relevant information about your surroundings. When an encounter begins, you may use the same roll’s results for Initiative, if the encounter is related to what you are Investigating.

actions.name: Retrain
actions.effect: Move 1 already spent Talent Point to another Talent you qualify for. You cannot retrain away from a Talent in your Origin Constellation, a Root Talent, a Talent that another Talent you own requires, or a Talent that would reduce your Proficiency Rank in a Constellation.

actions.name: Train
actions.effect: You work with a teacher, a rival, or a manual. You gain a Flare for the particular training pursued, subject to GM approval as described in Chapter 7. You may benefit from Train only once between one Milestone and the next.

actions.name: Strike
actions.effect:
Attack with a weapon, an unarmed blow, or another type of gear. Attempt the appropriate check against the appropriate Defense:
❶ Quick Strike. A one-action Strike to the Torso, with the following effects:
Critical Hit One weapon die plus Precision Damage (if any).
Hit One weapon die plus Precision Damage (if any). Protection applies even if the struck Zone is Exposed.
Graze No damage.
Miss No damage.
❷ Deliberate Strike. A two-action Strike, with the following effects:
Critical Hit Double damage to a Zone of your choosing. After rolling damage, you may Expose the Zone you struck if it was not already Exposed.
Hit Normal damage to the Torso.
Graze One weapon die plus Precision Damage (if any).
Miss You are Exposed in a Zone of your target’s choice.
❸ Committed Strike. A three-action Strike, with the following effects:
Critical Hit Double damage to a Zone of your choosing. After rolling damage, you may Expose the Zone you struck if it was not already Exposed.
Hit Normal damage to the Torso. After rolling damage, you may Expose the Zone you struck if it was not already Exposed.
Graze One weapon die plus Precision Damage (if any). You are Exposed in a Zone of your target’s choice.
Miss You are Exposed in a Zone of your target’s choice.

actions.name: Cast
actions.effect:
Attack with a magic spell. Attempt the appropriate check against the appropriate Defense:
❷ Quick Cast. See Spell for details, but generally: One damage die plus Precision Damage (if any); One target; No significant additional effect; No damage on Graze or Miss.
❸ Focused Cast. See Spell for details, but generally: Full damage dice plus Precision Damage (if any); use the spell’s normal effects; One damage die plus Precision Damage (if any) on Graze.
❹ Committed Cast. See Spell for details, but generally: Full damage dice plus Precision Damage (if any); additional spell effects such as expanded area.
Special A Cast of 3 or more actions gains the Prepared trait.
actions.constellation: Elementalism, Forceweaving, Vitalism, Mindweading, or Spiritcraft

actions.name: Close
actions.requirements: You Control a foe’s weapon.
actions.effect: Step toward that foe. The Bind does not end due to this movement, and the Controlled weapon cannot Intercept you.

actions.name: Gain Control
actions.requirements: You are in a Bind with your target, and they are no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Roll Melee against the target’s Guard, with the following effects:
Critical Success You Control the weapon, and the target is Off-Guard until its next Opportunity.
Success You Control the weapon.
Failure A neutral Bind forms.
Critical Failure You pressed badly. The target Controls your weapon instead.
Special While you Control the weapon, the target takes −2 Situation to attacks with it and has an Exposed Zone of your choice.

actions.name: Reload
actions.requirements: You are holding a weapon that requires ammunition.
actions.effect: You reload the weapon.

actions.name: Pass
actions.effect: Do nothing at this Opportunity. You may still use Reactions.

actions.name: Raise a Shield
actions.effect: Gain your shield's Gear bonus to Guard until your next Opportunity. You must be wielding it.

actions.name: Recenter
actions.effect: Clear every Exposed Zone on you and end any Bind you are in.

actions.name: Take Cover
actions.requirements: You are in or adjacent to a space that provides Cover or Greater Cover, or you are wielding a tower shield.
actions.effect:
Press yourself into your cover. Your Cover improves by one grade. Adjust the Zones Covered to match. This lasts until you Move, Step or Attack.
Special A raised tower shield gives you Cover with nothing to get behind, so Taking Cover behind one gives you Greater cover.

actions.name: Move
actions.effect: Move up to your Speed.

actions.name: Step
actions.effect:
Move up to half your Speed. You cannot Step into difficult terrain.
Note: Since Step does not have the Motion trait, it does not provoke Intercepts or other Reactions.

actions.name: Crawl
actions.effect: While prone, Move up to half your Speed.

actions.name: Drop Prone
actions.effect: Drop Prone or Supine, your choice.

actions.name: Rush
actions.effect: Move in a straight line up to three times your Speed, with your Load Strain subtracted once from that maximum distance. You are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Stand
actions.requirements: You are Prone or Supine.
actions.effect: Stand up from being Prone or Supine.

actions.name: Squeeze
actions.requirements: You are entering a space narrower than your token size, but at least half as wide.
actions.effect:
Move up to half your Speed. While any part of you is in that space:
• You are Off-Guard.
• You cannot Evade.
• You can attack only with weapons that have the Close trait.

actions.name: Aid
actions.requirements: An ally is willing to accept your aid.
actions.effect:
You use an action to help an ally. You must explain to the GM exactly how you're trying to help and what Constellation you would like to aid your ally with. The GM can add any relevant traits to your action depending on the situation. Attempt a Relevant check vs. a Threshold set by the GM (typically 15), with the following effects:
Critical Success Until your next Opportunity, the first time your ally attempts a check with the Constellation you specified, they gain a +2 Situation bonus to the check. If you're a master with the check you attempted, the bonus is +3, and if you're legendary, it's +4.
Success Until your next Opportunity, the first time your ally attempts a check with the Constellation you specified, they gain a +1 Situation bonus to the check.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure If your ally attempts a check with the Constellation you specified, you grant them a -1 Situation penalty to the check.

actions.name: Seek
actions.effect:
Attempt an Awareness check vs. Stealth of anything Hiding, or against a Threshold the GM sets. Covers everything within 30 feet, with the following effects:
Critical Success As Success, but the creature moves two states.
Success The creature moves one state toward Observed: Undetected becomes Hidden, Hidden becomes Concealed, Concealed becomes Observed.
Failure You learn nothing.
Critical Failure You believe something is there when it isn’t.

actions.name: Point Out
actions.effect: Indicate a square that is you believe contains a creature or object that is at least Hidden to you. It becomes Hidden rather than Undetected, or Concealed rather than Hidden, to any ally who can hear or see you.

actions.name: Interact
actions.effect: Draw or stow a weapon, open a door, pull a potion from your pack, pick something up, work a lever.

actions.name: Release
actions.effect: Drop or let go of something you are holding.

actions.name: Recall Knowledge
actions.description: You draw on your learning and experience to recognize a danger, place something unfamiliar, or recall a detail that could make all the difference.
actions.effect:
Effect Roll a Relevant check (to potentially recall or discover relevant information about a specific topic) vs. a Threshold the GM determines, with the following results, depending on how many actions you took:
❶ Quick Recall.
Critical Success Recall two useful facts.
Success Recall a useful fact.
Failure Nothing happens.
Critical Failure Recall a plausible but incorrect fact.

❷ Study.
Critical Success Recall two useful facts.
Success Recall a useful fact.
Failure Nothing happens.
Critical Failure Nothing happens.
Note: If used on a creature, you may ask about things as an attack or defense Threshold, Protection, Resistance, Immunity, Weakness, special ability, or other defined aspect.

actions.name: Steady the Line
actions.trigger: An adjacent ally would become Exposed.
actions.description: You take the blow's momentum on your own guard, and your ally keeps their footing.
actions.effect: The adjacent ally does not become Exposed.

actions.name: Quench the Ember
actions.requirements: You are taking persistent fire damage.
actions.description: You can draw the heat of a lingering flame inward until its last trace gutters out.
actions.effect: End one instance of persistent fire damage on yourself. This does not remove its source, prevent a new application, or extinguish an independently burning object.
actions.automation: [EFFECT: End Persistent Fire Damage; LIMIT: encounter]

rules.error: "EFFECT:" is not a feature keyword: write TRAIT, SIZE, SPEED, VIGOR, SENSES, LANGUAGE, POINT, MANEUVER, TALENT, CHOICE, AURA, EFFECT, or `[<Constellation> trained]`; an effect goes in `[EFFECT <tag>: ...]`
rules.text: [EFFECT: End Persistent Fire Damage; LIMIT: encounter]

actions.name: Glimmer
actions.description: The small image you hold in the air unfolds into a fuller display.
actions.effect: Create either a stationary visual image no larger than a 1-foot cube, or a stationary mote that sheds bright light for 15 feet and dim light for 15 feet beyond that. You must have line of effect to its location. The image is visibly illusory, has no substance or sound, cannot create readable text, and cannot provide Cover or Concealment. You can Sustain one Glimmer; creating another ends the first. It ends if you become unconscious.

actions.name: Quick Tongue
actions.requirements: You're in a settlement or community, and you haven't used Quick Tongue in this settlement or community within the past month.
actions.trigger: You critically fail a Diplomacy check.
actions.description: You catch a conversation as it slips, turning an ill-chosen word into a chance to begin again.
actions.effect: Reroll the triggering Diplomacy check, using the second result.

actions.name: Oathbound
actions.description: When someone breaks faith with you, certainty steadies your hand and steels your resolve.
actions.effect: Name one creature that has either formally challenged you, or that has broken a bargain or a truce with you. You gain a +1 Condition bonus to Attack checks and Defense checks against that creature until the encounter ends.
actions.automation:
[EFFECT MARK: enemies]
[EFFECT ATK: 1 condition; IFT: MARKED]
[EFFECT DEF: 1 condition; IFT: MARKED]

actions.name: Rescue Haul
actions.requirements: Enough free hands and carrying capacity to carry or drag your Target.
actions.description: You find a secure grip and a clear route before someone else’s strength gives out.
actions.effect:
Attempt an Athletics check against the terrain’s Threshold (Typically 15), with the following effects:
Critical Success Move up to your Speed, bringing the creature with you.
Success Move up to half your Speed, bringing it with you.
Failure Neither of you moves.
Critical Failure Neither of you moves, and you fall Prone.
When you move, place the creature in an adjacent unoccupied space at the end. Your movement provokes Reactions normally; the carried creature’s movement does not separately trigger them. It retains its conditions, including Prone if it was already Prone. This grants it no action or Opportunity.
actions.target: An adjacent willing or helpless creature of your Size or smaller

actions.name: Balance
actions.requirements: You can stand on or reach the narrow or unstable surface.
actions.effect:
Attempt an Acrobatics check against a Threshold set by the GM, with the following results:
Critical Success Move up to your Speed along the surface
Success Move up to half your Speed along the surface
Failure You do not make progress.
Critical Failure You lose your footing and slip or fall.
While on a surface that requires Balance checks, you are Off-Guard.

actions.name: Escape
actions.requirements: You are Grabbed or Restrained.
actions.effect:
Attempt your best of Athletics or Acrobatics against the grabber's Endure, or a Threshold set by the GM, with the following results, depending on how many actions you took:
❶ Quick Escape.
Critical Success or Success You are no longer Grabbed or Restrained.
Failure The Grabbed or Restrained condition persists.
Critical Failure The condition persists and their hold improves. If you were Grabbed, you are now Restrained.

❷ Deliberate Escape.
Critical Success You are no longer Grabbed or Restrained, and may Step.
Success You are no longer Grabbed or Restrained.
Failure or Critical Failure The Grabbed or Restrained condition persists.

actions.name: Grab an Edge
actions.requirements: You have a hand free. You may Release an item as part of this Reaction to free a hand.
actions.trigger: You fall past an edge, ledge, or handhold within your reach.
actions.effect:
Attempt your best of Athletics or Acrobatics against a Threshold of 15, with the following effects:
Critical Success You grab the edge and pull yourself up in the same motion. You do not fall.
Success You grab the edge and hang there until you use an action to pull yourself up to an unoccupied space. You are Off-Guard while you are hanging and cannot Evade.
Failure You slow yourself down via one or more failed edge grabs, but the damage caused by falling distance is reduced by 10 feet.
Critical Failure You fall the full distance.

actions.name: Tumble Through
actions.requirements: You are adjacent to a hostile creature.
actions.effect:
Attempt an Acrobatics check vs. your target’s Awareness, with the following results:
Critical Success Move up to your Speed through your target’s space (and beyond, if you have enough Speed remaining).
Success Move up to half your Speed through your target’s space (and beyond, if you have enough Speed remaining).
Failure Nothing happens.
Critical Failure You make a mistake, and are Wrong-Footed to your target until the end of their next Opportunity.
Note: Regardless of your result, Moving through a hostile creature’s space counts as Difficult Terrain.

actions.name: Tumbling Retreat
actions.effect: Step your full Speed. You must end up further than you started from at least one foe.

actions.name: Kip Up
actions.requirements: You are Prone or Supine.
actions.effect: Stand up. This movement doesn't trigger Reactions.

actions.name: Calm Animal
actions.requirements: An animal within 15 feet can perceive you, and you have never attacked it.
actions.effect:
Attempt an Animal Handling check against the animal’s Guard, with the following results, depending on how many actions you took:
❷ Quick Calm.
Critical Success Suppress 2 points of its Frightened value until the end of its next Opportunity.
Success Suppress 1 point of its Frightened value until the end of its next Opportunity.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure It avoids your approach, and you cannot try again this encounter.
❸ Deliberate Calm.
Critical Success Recall two useful facts.
Success Recall a useful fact.
Failure or Critical Failure Nothing happens.
Note: A Success or Critical Success also lets a non-hostile animal tolerate a simple contact, such as taking its reins. Threatening it ends that tolerance.
This does not end hostility or magical control.

actions.name: Direct Animal
actions.requirements: A willing animal trained for the cue is within 30 feet, can perceive it, has an action to spend, and has not been Directed this round.
actions.effect:
Give one cue to Move, Step, or Interact. A calm animal complies without a check. Under distraction or fear, attempt an Animal Handling check against the animal’s Guard, with the following results:
Critical Success or Success The animal carries out its cue immediately, spending ❶ from its own pool. This is not a reaction.
Failure or Critical Failure No effect.

actions.name: Train Animal
actions.requirements: A willing and able animal, regular care, and a reward or routine suited to it.
actions.effect: Teach one simple cue, such as stay, come, carry, or heel. Three workdays is the minimum for a simple cue in a domestic or already accustomed animal; the GM sets a longer period for unfamiliar or demanding behavior. This Endeavor does not domesticate a hostile wild animal or grant Attacks or extra actions.

actions.name: Sure Seat
actions.trigger: Your mount falls Prone, and an adjacent space can fit your token.
actions.description: You know when to leave a falling saddle and how to land clear.
actions.effect: You dismount into an adjacent empty space.

actions.name: Climb
actions.requirements: You are standing adjacent to the surface you wish to Climb.
actions.effect:
Attempt an Athletics check against a Threshold set by the GM, with the following results:
Critical Success Move up to your Speed along the surface
Success Move up to half your Speed along the surface
Failure You do not make progress.
Critical Failure You lose your grip and fall.
While Climbing, you are Off-Guard.

actions.name: Disarm
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or a weapon with the Disarm Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Attempt an Athletics check against your target’s Evade or Guard, with the following effects, depending on how many actions you took:
❷ Quick Disarm.
Critical Success The item drops from their grip and lands in one of their squares.
Success Their grip is loosened: they suffer a -2 Situation penalty to attacks with it, and future Disarm attempts against them gain a +2 Situation bonus, until they spend an Interact to resettle their grip.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
❸ Wrench.
Critical Success The item flies from their grip and lands 1d10 feet away, in a direction of your choosing.
Success The item drops from their grip and lands in one of their squares.
Failure You overcommit and are Wrong-Footed to your target until your next Opportunity.
Critical Failure You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Grapple
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or a weapon with the Grapple Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Attempt an Athletics check against your target’s Evade or Guard, with the following effects, depending on how many actions you took:
❶ Quick Grab.
Critical Success The target is Restrained until the start of your next Opportunity.
Success The target is Grabbed until the your next Opportunity.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
❷ Tackle.
Critical Success The target is knocked Prone or Supine (your choice, subject to GM judgment call), and Restrained until your next Opportunity.
Success The target is knocked Prone or Supine (your choice, subject to GM judgment call), and Grabbed until your next Opportunity. You fall Prone adjacent to them.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure You overcommit and fall Prone.

actions.name: Leap
actions.effect:
The following actions normally do not require a check; longer or higher Leaps, or Leaps under certain circumstances, may require an Athletics check against a Threshold set by the GM.
Quick Jump ❶ Leap up to half your Speed (less your Load Strain) in feet.
Standing Long Jump ❷ Leap up to your Speed (less your Load Strain) in feet.
Running Long Jump ❸ Move at least half your Speed and Leap in the same direction up to your 1.5x of your Speed (less your Load Strain) in feet.

actions.name: Reposition
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or are already Grabbing or Restraining the target, the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Attempt an Athletics check against your target’s Evade or Guard, with the following effects, depending on how many actions you took:
❶ Quick Reposition.
Critical Success Move the target up to 6 feet, staying within your reach, not into or through obstacles.
Success Move the target up to 3 feet, staying within your reach, not into or through obstacles.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure The target can move you up to 3 feet as though it Repositioned you.
❷ Haul.
Critical Success Move up to your Speed, bringing the target with you.
Success Move up to half your Speed, bringing the target with you.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure The target can Move you, as if it got a Critical Success on you.

actions.name: Shove
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or a weapon with the Shove Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Attempt an Athletics check vs. Evade or Guard, with the following effects, depending on how many actions you took:
❶ Push.
Critical Success The target is pushed up to your Speed. You may Move as part of this action, if it is in the same direction.
Success The target is pushed up to half your Speed.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
❷ Heave.
Critical Success The target is pushed up to double your Speed. You may Move as part of this action, if it is in the same direction.
Success The target is pushed up to your Speed.
Failure You are Wrong-Footed against the target until your next Opportunity.
Critical Failure You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Swim
actions.requirements: You are in a liquid such as water (GM’s discretion as to whether it is deep enough or swimmable).
actions.effect:
Attempt an Athletics check against a Threshold set by the GM, with the following results:
Critical Success Move up to your Speed through the liquid.
Success Move up to half your Speed through the liquid.
Failure You do not make progress.
Critical Failure You do not make progress, and you sink 5 feet.
While Swimming, you are Off-Guard.

actions.name: Trip
actions.requirements: You have a free hand or a weapon with the Trip Trait, and the target must be within reach and no more than one Size larger than you.
actions.effect:
Attempt an Athletics check vs. Evade or Guard, with the following effects, depending on how many actions you took:
❶ Quick Trip.
Critical Success or Success The target is knocked Prone.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
❷ Leg Sweep.
Critical Success The target is knocked Prone, and takes damage equal to your Might.
Success The target is knocked Prone.
Failure You are Wrong-Footed against the target until your next Opportunity.
Critical Failure You overcommit and are Off-Guard until your next Opportunity.
Special If the target’s Legs are Exposed, increase the degree of success by one.

actions.name: Bull Rush
actions.description: You drive forward with the force of your approach behind your hands.
actions.effect:
Move in a straight line up to your Speed, then Shove ❶ a creature within reach, with the following additional effects:
Critical Success Add 1 foot to the Shove results for every foot you Moved.
Success Add 1 foot to the Shove results for every 2 feet you Moved.

actions.name: Reliable Anchor
actions.requirements: You have a free hand and are not in danger of falling, yourself.
actions.trigger: A willing creature no more than one Size Larger that you falls within your reach.
actions.description: When a companion loses their hold, yours is the hand they find.
actions.effect:
Attempt an Athletics check against Threshold 15, with the following effects:
Critical Success You catch a part of the creature and help it swing into an adjacent unoccupied space.
Success You catch a part of the creature, and you and the creature are Off-Guard until your or it spends an action to swing it into an adjacent unoccupied space.
Failure or Critical Failure You do not catch the creature.

actions.name: Brace an Object
actions.requirements: Tools or suitable bracing material; an unattended door, support, container, or similar object within reach.
actions.effect:
Attempt a Crafting check against a Threshold set by the GM, with the following results:
Critical Success +3 Situation bonus to its Threshold against forcing open or breaking it for 1 minute.
Success +2 Situation bonus to its Threshold against forcing open or breaking it for 1 minute.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure The bracing jams the object; removing it takes a Interact action.
Bracing cannot improve worn armor, a carried shield, an Attack, or a creature’s Defense, and requires physically sufficient material.

actions.name: Field Patch
actions.requirements: Tools and expendable repair material; a reachable mundane object with minor, repairable damage or a jam.
actions.effect:
Attempt a Crafting check against a Threshold set by the GM, with the following results:
Critical Success Restore the object’s ordinary function for 10 minutes.
Success Restore the object’s ordinary function for 1 minute.
Failure or Critical Failure No effect.
An object can benefit from one Field Patch until it receives a proper repair. This cannot replace a missing major component, restore a destroyed object, refill a consumable, restore charges, or improve statistics.

actions.name: Survey Workmanship
actions.requirements: You can inspect an exposed object or structure closely.
actions.effect:
After spending 10 minutes surveying the workmanship of an object or structure, attempt a Crafting check against a Threshold set by the GM, with the following results:
Critical Success Find two useful details and a plausible way to address them.
Success Find one useful detail and a plausible way to address it.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure Produce a mistaken assessment that the GM grounds in what you inspected.
This examines visible workmanship to look for things like material flaws, unsafe joints, or practical construction details; hidden triggers still require detection, usually with Awareness.

actions.name: Rally
actions.description: You bring a companion’s attention back to what they can still do.
actions.effect:
Attempt a Diplomacy check vs. a Threshold set by the GM (typically 15), with the following effects:
Critical Success One willing ally within 30 feet who hears you gains a +1 Situation bonus to their next Defense before your next Opportunity, and may immediately Recenter.
Success One willing ally within 30 feet who hears you gains a +1 Situation bonus to their next Defense before your next Opportunity.
Failure or Critical Failure No effect.

actions.name: Talk Them Down
actions.description: A measured appeal gives an opponent a reason to hesitate.
actions.effect:
Attempt a Diplomacy check vs. Guard one creature within 30 feet that understands you, with the following effects:
Critical Success It takes a -2 Situation penalty to its next Attack against you before the end of the next round.
Success It takes a -2 Situation penalty to its next Attack against you until your next Opportunity.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure It gains a +1 Situation bonus to its next Attack against you until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Command the Field
actions.description: Your companions recognize the opening as soon as you call it.
actions.effect:
Attempt a Diplomacy check vs. a Threshold set by the GM (typically 15), with the following effects:
Critical Success One willing ally within 30 feet who hears you may each immediately Move.
Success One willing ally within 30 feet who hears you may each immediately Step.
Failure or Critical Failure No effect.

actions.name: Feint
actions.requirements: An enemy is within your reach.
actions.effect:
Attempt a Guile check vs. target's Awareness, with the following effects:
Critical Success The target is Wrong-Footed to you until the end of your next Opportunity.
Success The target is Wrong-Footed to you until your next Opportunity.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure You overcommit. You are Wrong-Footed to that creature until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Feinting Step
actions.description: Your opponent follows the suggestion of a movement while you take the real one.
actions.effect: Feint, the Step (regardless of the results of the Feint).

actions.name: Anticipate
actions.effect:
Frequency Once per round (per target)
Requirements One Observed creature within 30 feet has acted where you could perceive it this encounter.
Effect Attempt an Insight check vs. Guile, with the following effects:
Critical Success You gain a +2 Situation bonus to your next Defense against it until your next Opportunity.
Success You gain a +1 Situation bonus to your next Defense against it until your next Opportunity.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure You take a -1 Situation penalty to your next Defense against it until your next Opportunity.

actions.name: Demoralize
actions.effect:
Choose one creature that can hear you. Attempt an Intimidation check vs. Guard, with the following effects, depending on how many actions you took:
❶ Quick Demoralize.
Critical Success The target is Frightened 2.
Success The target is Frightened 1.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure The target is emboldened, gaining a +1 Situation bonus to Attacks against you until your next Opportunity.
❷ Break Them.
As Quick Demoralize, but you can target any amount of creatures within 30 feet that can hear you.
❸ Focused Demoralize.
Critical Success The target is Frightened 3 and Heedless until your next Opportunity.
Success The target is Frightened 2.
Failure or Critical Failure No effect.

actions.name: Battle Cry
actions.trigger: Initiative has been rolled, but nobody taken their Opportunity yet.
actions.description: You begin the exchange with a warning that reaches the whole enemy line.
actions.effect: Use the Demoralize ❷ Break Them Maneuver.

actions.name: No Quarter
actions.trigger: You reduce an enemy to 0 Vigor.
actions.description: An enemy falling gives your next warning a terrible clarity.
actions.effect: Use the Demoralize ❶ Quick Demoralize Maneuver on an enemy that saw you reduce the triggering enemy to 0 Vigor.

actions.name: Well-Read
actions.description: Long familiarity with your subject brings useful facts to mind in a heartbeat.
actions.effect: Recall Knowledge on your Lore’s subject.

actions.name: Convalescent Care
actions.requirements: Supplies, and up to 4 resting patients suffering from a nonmagical Affliction.
actions.effect:
Attempt a Medicine check vs. the illness or poison’s Threshold, with the following effects:
Critical Success Each treated patient gets a +2 Situation bonus to their next Endure check against the Affliction within 24 hours.
Success Each treated patient gets a +1 Situation bonus to their next Endure check against the Affliction within 24 hours.
Failure or Critical Failure grants no bonus.

Note: Use one check for patients receiving the same care for the same condition; otherwise check each separately. Patients still make their own checks.

actions.name: Stabilize
actions.requirements: You have appropriate first-aid supplies, and are adjacent to a willing or helpless Dying creature that has not been targeted by Stabilize this round.
actions.effect:
Attempt a Medicine check vs. 10 + the patient’s Dying value + its total Wounds, with the following effects:
Critical Success Set Dying to 0; end one instance of Persistent damage affecting it.
Success Set Dying to 0.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure Increase Dying by 1.

actions.name: Treat Persistent Damage
actions.requirements: You are adjacent to a willing or helpless creature that has not been targeted by Treat Persistent Damage this round.
actions.effect: Make a plausible case to the GM to explain how your actions will help your patient. At the GM's discretion, the patient's next Endure check against the Persistent Damage will receive up to a +1 Situation bonus for each action you spent treating it.

actions.name: Treat Wounds
actions.requirements: Appropriate supplies, and a willing or helpless patient who is not Dying.
actions.effect:
After spending 1 hour on this Activity, attempt a Medicine check vs. 10 + the patient’s total Wounds, with the following effects:
Critical Success Two Wounds are healed.
Success One Wound is healed.
Failure or Critical Failure No effect.

actions.name: Bolster
actions.requirements: One willing ally within 15 feet can hear your brief encouraging performance.
actions.effect:
Attempt a Performance check against a Threshold set by the GM (typically 15), with the following effects:
Critical Success The ally gains a +2 Situation bonus to their next Defense against a Fear effect until the end of the next round.
Success The ally gains a +1 Situation bonus to their next Defense against a Fear effect until the end of the next round.
Failure or Critical Failure No effect.

actions.name: Captivate
actions.requirements: Up to three creatures within 30 feet can perceive the performance and are not facing immediate violence or another urgent danger.
actions.effect:
Attempt a Performance check once vs. against each target’s Awareness, with the following effects:
Critical Success It takes a -1 Situation penalty to Awareness checks until the end of your next Opportunity, unless you Sustain it.
Success It takes a -1 Situation penalty to Awareness checks until the end of your next Opportunity, unless you Sustain it.
Failure or Critical Failure No effect.

If a target is Attacked, the penalty immediately ends.

actions.name: Hide
actions.requirements: You have Concealment or at least Lesser Cover.
actions.effect:
Attempt one Stealth check, compared separately against the Awareness of each creature that can currently locate you and from which you have Concealment or at least Lesser Cover. Apply the following results separately to each creature:
Critical Success or Success You become Hidden to that creature.
Failure Your awareness state relative to that creature does not change.
Critical Failure As Failure, and you are Wrong-Footed to that creature until your next Opportunity.
Note on Existing Stealth: You remain Hidden or Undetected to creatures to which you already had that state. Hide does not make a creature forget that you are present.
Note on Cover and Concealment: Check these separately for each creature. You cannot use Hide to become Hidden from a creature against which you lack the required Cover or Concealment.

actions.name: Sneak
actions.requirements: You are (or believe you are) Hidden or Undetected from at least one creature.
actions.effect:
Choose a route and destination within half your Speed. Before moving, attempt one Stealth check, compared separately against the Awareness of each creature that could detect your movement and to which you are currently Hidden or Undetected. Follow your chosen route, applying the following results separately to each creature:
❶ Quick Sneak.
Critical Success or Success You retain your previous awareness state relative to that creature throughout the movement.
Failure The creature detects your movement at the first point along your route where it could do so.
Critical Failure As Failure, and you are Wrong-Footed to that creature until your next Opportunity.
❷ Creep. You move cautiously enough to recognize danger before committing. After rolling, but before Moving, you may choose to abandon the entire movement. You remain in your starting space and retain your previous awareness states. Both actions are still spent. If you proceed, resolve the results above, except a Critical Failure does not make you Wrong-Footed.
Note on Ending in the Open: Against a creature that could otherwise see you, your destination must provide Concealment or at least Lesser Cover. Otherwise, it detects you regardless of your check.
Note on Being Detected: Crossing open ground during the movement does not itself reveal you. If detected, a creature that detects you treats you as Observed if it can see you clearly, Concealed if Concealment still applies, or Hidden if it can sense your presence but cannot see you.
Note on Hide vs. Sneak: Sneak does not itself improve your awareness state relative to any creature. Use Hide to become Hidden from a creature that already knows your location.

actions.name: Lost in the Dark
actions.trigger: An Attack against you has Missed, and you can Hide.
actions.effect: Perform the Hide maneuver.

actions.name: Find Footing
actions.effect:
Attempt a Survival check against your target's Threshold, with the following effects:
Critical Success You can Move and Step through your target as if it were not Difficult Terrain.
 Success You can Move through your target as if it were not Difficult Terrain, though you still cannot Step through it.
Failure or Critical Failure No effect.
actions.target: One adjacent, contiguous field of Nonmagical Difficult Terrain
actions.duration: For the remainder of the encounter

actions.name: Disable Device
actions.requirements: You are holding a Thievery Toolkit, or you are wearing one and have at least one hand free.
actions.effect:
Attempt a Thievery check vs. a Threshold set by the GM, with the following effects:
Critical Success You disable the device, or you achieve two successes toward disabling a device requiring more than one success. You leave no trace of your tampering, and you can rearm the device later, if that type of device can be rearmed.
Success You disable the device, or you achieve one success toward disabling a device that requires more than one success.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure You trigger the device.
actions.target: One device you are adjacent to or holding

actions.name: Pick Lock
actions.requirements: You are holding a Thievery Toolkit, or you are wearing one and have at least one hand free.
actions.effect:
Attempt a Thievery check vs. a Threshold set by the GM, with the following effects:
Critical Success You unlock the lock, or you achieve two successes toward opening a lock that requires more than one success. You leave no trace of your tampering.
Success You open the lock, or you achieve one success toward opening a lock that requires more than one success. You leave behind damage that indicates the lock was picked on close scrutiny.
Failure No effect.
Critical Failure You break your toolkit and leave behind obvious damage. Fixing a broken toolkit requires using Crafting to Repair it or else swapping in replacement picks (costing 3 sp, or 3 gp for an infiltrator thieves' toolkit).
actions.target: One lock you are adjacent to or holding
